authoring: Extracted by SportFisherGameplay (Art/_sportFisherGameplay.js) from the rig source at the hash above — the rig itself is unedited. Polygons are computed by the rig’s own station/hbOf/dfrac/sheerZ/bowRake and the house volumes’ own plan functions; fit-out footprints are transcribed hull-spec literals with per-item provenance. Rig tuning constants (F/MATS/GAIN/BIAS/LN) stay in the rig. Do not hand-edit — re-run the extractor.
extractor_contract: per section: rig export -> this sidecar -> absent section = hull does not support the feature (not an error).

DECK.note: Teak-planked working sole, transom (y=-13.7) forward to the salon’s aft wall taken down to sole height (y=-10.413); half-width = rig dw(u) = (hbOf(u,dfrac)-TH)*0.965. The rig draws this sole on to y=-9.6, i.e. 0.813 m of it runs UNDER the salon — trimmed here, because that strip is inside the house. The sole sits deep in this hull (z=2.05 on a 3.15 m transom sheer) — that is the point of a fishing cockpit.

_excluded.WASHBOARD: NO washboards on this hull, and this is the load-bearing absence. The rig draws a deck margin alongside the house, but measured at the deck line it is 0.071–0.612 m wide (11 samples, y -9.65 → 1.53, widening only as the house nose narrows into the foredeck): a reveal between the house side and the covering board, not a strip anyone walks. It is that narrow by design — clampHW lands the house sides on the cap so the covering board reads as ONE unbroken line stem to transom. Consequence: cockpit and foredeck are separate walkable islands on the exterior.
_excluded.covering_board: The teak cap outboard of the reveal is rolled and carries a toe rail lifting to 0.2 m forward of u=0.55 — a boundary, not a surface.
_excluded.house_interior: Salon and skylounge are modelled as an exterior volume only — no interior floor exists to walk.
_excluded.bridge_access_interior: The only modelled climb is aft deck → bridge sole (DECK.bridge_sole._notes.bridge_ladder). Salon and skylounge interiors are not modelled.
_excluded.foredeck_access: Nothing in the rig connects the cockpit to the foredeck: no margin wide enough to walk, no ladder, no door in the house exterior other than the aft glass. Any walk-forward move a character makes on this hull has to be authored game-side.
_excluded.gear_above: Outriggers, tower pipework, whips, radomes, hardtop slab and rod tubes are gear over the decks, not surfaces. Rod points are ANCHORS.rods.
_excluded.topside_detail: Hull windows, louvre vents and the boot/cove bands are paint and detail, outside any walkable surface.

_confirm.cleat_identification: All three CLEATS entries are read from unlabelled iron fittings (see each provenance). Positions are exact; the reading as tie-offs is the art side’s, and a gameplay ruling can demote any of them.
_confirm.upper_decks: bridge_sole, aft_deck are included because they are real modelled surfaces with real dimensions. If gameplay only ever walks the cockpit, mezzanine, side decks and foredeck, the upper polygons are inert data — they are not a claim that a character can reach them.
